data.description:
## Goal
Create the P1 typed-enum schema contract and the machine-readable verdict checker script. T1's test suite must be written first (RED) and must pass after this task (GREEN).

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/verifier-verdict.md (P1 enum schema: PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED|INCONCLUSIVE, narrative template)
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh (reads P1 from stdin JSON; exits 0=PASS, 1=non-PASS, 2=missing/invalid)

## Acceptance Criteria
- chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh
- bash tests/scripts/test-check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 0 (all 6 unit cases GREEN)
- verifier-verdict.md documents: enum values, narrative template fields, schema_version=2 requirement
- check-verifier-verdict.sh reads JSON from stdin or file argument; never from /tmp paths

## Testing Mode
RED (depends T1)
data.title: T2: RED — Create verifier-verdict.md contract + check-verifier-verdict.sh
